svg.title: Test a small app one change at a time
svg.desc: A counter lets you check each edit by pressing a button and watching the result. Describe. Name the buttons and the numbers they should show. Build and try. Open the preview and press the controls in a known order. Fix and retest. Describe one wrong result. Repeat the same button presses after the edit.
